rules.title: Measure first
rules.text: Measure before optimizing; do not trade readability for unmeasured gains.

rules.title: Avoid N+1 queries
rules.text: Avoid N+1 queries; batch or join database access.

rules.title: Paginate large results
rules.text: Paginate or stream large result sets instead of loading everything into memory.

rules.title: Lazy-load heavy code
rules.text: Lazy-load heavy modules and assets that are not needed on first render.

rules.title: Cache with invalidation
rules.text: Add caching only with a clear key, TTL and invalidation strategy.

rules.title: Index hot queries
rules.text: Index columns used in hot queries and verify with a query plan.

rules.title: Watch bundle size
rules.text: Keep client bundle size in check and avoid importing whole libraries for one function.

rules.title: Avoid needless allocations
rules.text: Avoid allocating in hot loops and reuse buffers where profiling shows it matters.

rules.title: Do I/O concurrently
rules.text: Run independent I/O operations concurrently with a bounded concurrency limit.

rules.title: Performance budgets
rules.text: Respect existing performance budgets and fail the change if it regresses them.
